He sees the pouch and asks; she shyly deflects. E (07:15–07:24): Mohan enters her room and opens the pouch without consent, later imagines her in costume while alone; the fantasy ends explicitly with a return to reality. Meenakshi is not physically present and is unaware. Meenakshi is unaware. Getting ready (07:37–07:40): nursing bra, plum front-button kurta, cream palazzo, open grey cardigan, one-shoulder dupatta, earrings, watch, hospital bag. Costume set and blindfold remain in private pouch for Nikhil, never hospital attire.

timeline.title: Preparation Before Rounds — Cleaning Sign and Unnoticed Presence
timeline.summary: Meenakshi overlooks the Cleaning in Progress board and uses the women's staff changing area for an approximately eight-to-ten-minute milk-expression routine and change into hospital attire. Harish and Sunil are present behind the service partition; Sunil calls out, but she does not hear clearly. She secures her locker and departs for rounds at 09:05, unaware.
timeline.detail: At 08:46 a yellow CLEANING IN PROGRESS — PLEASE WAIT notice stands at the door. She is focused on rounds and her practical lactation/storage routine. Senior ward attendant Harish Pal (62) and floor cleaner Sunil Yadav (46) are arranging cleaning supplies behind partition. Sunil softly tells Harish that doctor madam has entered, then calls louder to announce cleaning; she does not clearly hear. The workers hesitate because of fear of confrontation/complaint, do not promptly exit or safeguard privacy, and remain. No explicit sexualized depiction; their decision to remain is a privacy violation and not consent. Milk expression is described clinically, followed by changing to professional attire, white coat and ID check. Her personal belongings and pump kit are secured in the locked locker by 09:05. Later a colleague will inform her, source and time to be defined in a later scene.
